subject: Sprint Booster: request for conditional credit top-up and trial extension
messages:
From: Sylvia Lee <sylvia@clearwave.ai>
To: ava_chen@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: short extension + small top-up for Sprint trial

Hi Ava,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — the team loved the latency and the dedicated routing options. We kicked off a small pilot over the weekend and already hit 72% of our monthly token budget (surprising, but the RLHF layer is chatty).

We wanted to ask whether Redwood can approve a short 30-day extension on the trial window and a small one-time credit top-up (~$1,500) to cover the burst through our next milestone on Jul 31.

Quick context:
- Use case: in-product assistant for onboarding (high prompt diversity)
- Current activity: 9k messages, 2.4M tokens across the sandbox environment
- Next milestone: light‑weight NPS study and demo for investor day on Jul 31

I attached a CSV with the usage snapshot and a short milestone checklist. If there are any required commitments for the extension (e.g., feature call, case study permission), we can commit.

Appreciate any flexibility here — this pilot could convert quickly if we get through the investor milestone.

Best,
Sylvia Lee
Co-founder, ClearWave Labs
(sylvia@clearwave.ai)

Attachments: ClearWave-usage-snapshot.csv

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.ai>

Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-09T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short extension + small top-up for Sprint trial

Hi Sylvia — thanks for the context and the usage file, that helps.

Short answer: we can usually offer a one-time credit top-up for pilot bursts and a 30-day extension on a case-by-case basis. I'd like to propose the following conditional approval so we can expedite:

- 30-day trial extension starting today
- $1,500 one-time credit applied to your sandbox for usage through Jul 31
- In exchange: a 15‑minute product check-in the week of Jul 22 and permission for a short anonymized quote if you convert

If that works, I'll loop in Ben for final sign-off and we can get an MOU queued. Please confirm acceptance and re-send the usage snapshot if you attach any redactions.

Cheers,
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.ai
